# scripts/Visual/Lights/Flicker.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../../scripts/Visual/Lights/Flicker.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Deterministic flame flicker in [-1, 1], used by Torch as energy * (1 + flicker * value).
Kind selects puff rate; salt decorrelates phases. Puff, half-harmonic, and drift weights sum to one.
A candle is steady until draft() supplies a brief high-frequency disturbance.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
